description: This file defines a PHP class 'perf_postgres' for performance monitoring and tuning of PostgreSQL databases within the ADOdb library. It includes SQL queries, configuration settings, and methods for database optimization and explanation of query plans.

classes.name: perf_postgres
classes.description: A class for PostgreSQL performance monitoring and optimization within ADOdb.

methods.name: optimizeTable
methods.description: Performs VACUUM operations on specified tables with different modes.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an EXPLAIN plan for a given SQL query and optionally filters based on partial matching.

methods.name: optimizeTable
methods.description: Performs vacuuming or analyze operations on a database table based on the specified mode.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an explain plan for a query, optionally filters for partial matches, and formats the output.
